text:
Type: stoneware pillar candle holder
Use: holding a pillar candle; on a mantel, console or dining table; living room, dining room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: glossy reactive glazed stoneware, unglazed speckled clay base
Colors: white with blue speckles, warm clay beige
Shape: turned baluster column, round drip tray top, stepped square base, slender and tall
Feel: warm, homey, crafted
Goes with: weathered wood, linen, cream and blue accents; farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic-Look Stoneware Decorative Candle Holder, 9.4 Inch Height, White and Clay
product.description: Different glazing techniques are used to create the two-tone effect of this candle holder. With classic and rustic touches, it holds 3" diameter candles or simply serves as a decorative piece. Allow for variations in color, as each is one of a kind. Off-white with blue speckles on the top, earth-tone clay color on base 100% stoneware. Glazing techniques produce a variegated color effect. 4.25"W x 4.25"D x 9.4"H Sturdy, durable piece for display or holding candles
